gen-flavors-gf-krona-one: Stubby, playful, a bit bossy. Flavors towers with diagonals as hefty as its stems, while Krona One spaces its sans letters loosely, with a lowercase built like cast-iron capitals.
gen-flavors-gf-martian-mono: Whimsy up front, structure behind it. Flavors stands tall with diagonals as hefty as its stems, while Martian Mono sets fixed-width monospace letters spread far apart with generous curve openings.
gen-fs-excon-gf-esteban: Efficient and crowded like chalk marks on a full slate, Excon leans on open terminals and a towering lowercase. Esteban, a serif, adds a hint of pen pressure in each curve.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-inika: Letters locked like chain links. New Title packs a tall lowercase with real punch, whereas Inika, a text serif, keeps a moderate lowercase and a see-through gap in each s.
